Welcome to Bixby Animal Hospital & Urgent Care, where we treat every pet like family!

Our team is devoted to offering exceptional veterinary care to the Torrance, CA community. We are committed to keeping your furry friends in top shape with our range of services, including preventive care, medical treatments, and more.

At our state-of-the-art facility, we combine advanced technology with a caring touch to ensure a comfortable experience for both pets and their owners. We’re not just your local vet—we’re your partners in your pet’s health journey. We look forward to becoming a trusted part of your pet’s life and supporting you as a dedicated pet parent.
